interpretation: TuneJury is an uncalibrated reward; MuQ cosines and margins describe prompt identity, not preference or significance.
selection: Eight presets were fixed from default-seed validation before fresh scoring; jazz-trio was restored to baseline after both fresh seeds regressed. The final result is adaptive and fresh is not untouched held-out validation.

preprocessing.normalization: none; TuneJury internal CLAP clips/quantizes; MuQ-MuLan uses float32
preprocessing.tunejury_prompt: empty text branch (512 zeros), official waveform API
preprocessing.window_selection: equally spaced first-to-last complete window; one segment uses center
preprocessing.aggregation: unweighted mean of valid excerpt rewards and cosines

prompts.purpose: Fixed descriptions of preset identity. Similarity is not musical quality or probability. Freeze this file before comparing renders.
